entries.3697d6df319ddb68: The company manufactures and sells rice processing machines, including sushi rice processing machines (sushi robots) and topping rice processing machines (topping robots). In Japan, these are sold directly to users and through packaging material trading companies, kitchen equipment trading companies and sales agents. Overseas, sales are made in North America through subsidiary Suzumo International Corporation, in the ASEAN region through Suzumo Singapore Corporation, and in other regions through trading companies in Japan and overseas.
entries.3dfef2e4c354cde2: A food processing machinery manufacturer that makes and sells cooked-rice processing machines such as sushi robots, delivering its products to more than 90 countries around the world.
entries.73d852893310378c: The company develops and sells store systems related to restaurants, including POS systems and self-order systems for restaurants.
entries.9b68cbb2adbe3470: This is a single segment centered on the manufacture and sale of rice processing machines, such as sushi robots and topping robots, and also handling hygiene materials and store systems. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,864 million; by region, Japan was ¥10,033 million, North America ¥2,481 million, and Asia ¥2,059 million.
entries.dc17eaba4135e9b1: Consolidated subsidiary Seha Japan Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells hygiene materials such as alcohol-based cleaners and disinfectants, and the company purchases and sells them.
